items.title: Chuck Israels interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 11, 2021
items.q: if you listen to a Mozart passage and it touches you somehow

ctx.x: And I believe that’s what you’re talking about and I really like what you just said because I struggle with this question of what does music mean, unless it’s descriptive or programmatic and it’s trying to describe something specifically, what does music mean? And I think it means enough if you listen to a Mozart passage and it touches you somehow, like he knew how to use the elements of music and combine them in a way that made me respond. Just like earlier this morning I was listening to your Concerto Peligroso…
